items.t: But He looks at your hearts
items.q: about Allah looking at hearts, not appearances
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) narrated:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Allah does not look at your figures, nor at your attire but He looks at your hearts and accomplishments".
ar: وعنْ أبي هريرةَ عبدِ الرحمانِ بنِ صخرٍ — رضي الله عنه —، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ الله — ﷺ: ﴿إنَّ الله لا ينْظُرُ إِلى أجْسَامِكُمْ، ولا إِلى صُوَرِكمْ، وَلَكن ينْظُرُ إلى قُلُوبِكمْ وأعمالكم﴾

items.t: I seek forgiveness more than seventy times a day
items.q: about how many times a day the Prophet ﷺ sought forgiveness
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
ru: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "I swear by Allah that I seek Allah's Pardon and turn to Him in repentance more than seventy times a day.".
ar: وعن أبي هريرةَ — رضي الله عنه — قَالَ: سمعْتُ رسولَ الله — ﷺ — يقول: ﴿والله إنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ الله وأَتُوبُ إِلَيْه في اليَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً﴾

items.t: Allah stretches out His hand at night
items.q: about Allah stretching out His hand by day and night to accept repentance
items.intro: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Allah, the Exalted, will continue to stretch out His Hand in the night so that the sinners of the day may repent, and continue to stretch His Hand in the daytime so that the sinners of the night may repent, until the sun rises from the west".
ar: ١٦- وعن أبي مُوسى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بنِ قَيْسٍ الأَشْعَرِيِّ —رضِي الله عنه— عن النَّبِيَّ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وسَلَّم قال: ﴿إِنَّ اللهَ تعالى يَبْسُطُ يَدَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ النَّهَارِ وَيَبْسُطُ يَدهُ بِالنَّهَارِ لِيَتُوبَ مُسِيءُ اللَّيْلِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِها﴾

items.t: All of his affairs are good, and that is only for the believer
items.q: about the amazing state of the believer: gratitude and patience
items.intro: Abu Yahya Suhaib bin Sinan (May Allah be pleased with him) reported that:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "How wonderful is the case of a believer; there is good for him in everything and this applies only to a believer. If prosperity attends him, he expresses gratitude to Allah and that is good for him; and if adversity befalls him, he endures it patiently and that is better for him".
ar: ٢٧- وَعَنْ أبي يَحْيَى صُهَيْبِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ الله صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وسَلَّم: ﴿عَجَباً لأمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ لَهُ خَيْرٌ، وَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ لأِحَدٍ إِلاَّ للْمُؤْمِن: إِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ سَرَّاءُ شَكَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْراً لَهُ، وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ ضَرَّاءُ صَبَرَ فَكَانَ خيْراً لَهُ﴾

items.t: Whoever Allah wishes good for, He afflicts with trials
items.q: about whom Allah tests with trials
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported that:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: "He whom Allah intends good, He makes him to suffer from some affliction".
ar: ٣٩- وعَنْ أَبي هُرَيرةَ رضِيَ اللَّهُ عنه قال: قال رسولُ اللَّهِ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وسَلَّم: ﴿مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْراً يُصِبْ مِنْهُ﴾:
وضَبطُوا ﴿يُصِب﴾: بفَتْحِ الصَّادِ وكَسْرِهَا.

items.t: The strong one is not the one who overcomes others, but the one who controls himself in anger
items.q: about who is truly strong
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The strong man is not one who is good at wrestling, but the strong man is one who controls himself in a fit of rage.".
ar: ٤٥- وعنْ أَبِي هُريرةَ رضي اللَّه عنه أَن رسول اللَّه صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وسَلَّم قال: ﴿لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذي يَمْلِكُ نَفْسَهُ عِنْدَ الْغَضَبِ﴾ متفقٌ عليه.
﴿والصُّرَعَةُ﴾ بِضمِّ الصَّادِ وفتْحِ الرَّاءِ، وأصْلُهُ عنْد الْعربِ منْ يصرَعُ النَّاسَ كثيراً.

items.t: Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise
items.q: about truthfulness and lying and where they lead
items.intro: Abdullah bin Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Truth leads to piety and piety leads to Jannah. A man persists in speaking the truth till he is enrolled with Allah as a truthful. Falsehood leads to vice and vice leads to the Fire (Hell), and a person persists on telling lies until he is enrolled as a liar".'.
ar: فَالأَوَّلُ: عَن ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ رضي اللَّه عنه عن النَّبِيَّ صَلّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وسَلَّم قال: ﴿إِنَّ الصَّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الجَنَّةِ، وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ ليصْدُقُ حَتَّى يُكتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ صِدِّيقاً، وإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الفجُورِ وَإِنَّ الفجُورَ يَهْدِي إِلَى النَّارِ، وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَكْذِبُ حَتَّى يُكتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ كَذَّاباً﴾ متفقٌ عليه.

items.t: Two blessings many people are deprived of: health and free time
items.q: about two blessings many people lose out on
items.intro: Ibn Abbas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There are two blessings in which many people incur loss. (They are) health and free time (for doing good)".
ar: ٩٧- الثالث: عن ابن عباس رضي اللَّه عنهما، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُول اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿نِعْمَتَانِ مَغبونٌ فيهما كَثيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ: الصِّحَّةُ، وَالفَرَاغُ﴾

items.t: The Fire is surrounded by desires and Paradise by hardships
items.q: about what surrounds the Fire and Paradise
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. "The (Hell) Fire is surrounded with all kinds of desires and passions, while Jannah is surrounded with adversities.".
ar: ١٠١- السابع: عَنْهُ: أنَّ رَسُول اللَّه ﷺ، قَالَ: ﴿حُجِبَتِ النَّارُ بالشَّهَواتِ، وَحُجِبَتِ الجَنَّةُ بِالمَكَارِهِ﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ.
وفي رواية لمسلم: ﴿حُفَّتْ﴾ بدل ﴿حُجِبَتْ﴾ وَهُوَ بمعناه: أي بينه وبينها هَذَا الحجاب فإذا فعله دخلها.

items.t: Three follow the deceased: his family, his wealth and his deeds
items.q: about the three that follow the deceased
items.intro: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Three follow a dead body: members of his family, his possessions and his deeds. Two of them return and one remains with him. His family and his possessions return; his deeds remain with him".
ar: ١٠٤- العاشر: عن أنس -رضي اللَّه عنه-، عن رَسُول اللَّه ﷺ، قَالَ: ﴿يَتْبَعُ المَيتَ ثَلاَثَةٌ: أهْلُهُ وَمَالُهُ وَعَملُهُ، فَيَرجِعُ اثنَانِ وَيَبْقَى وَاحِدٌ: يَرجِعُ أهْلُهُ وَمَالُهُ، وَيَبقَى عَملُهُ﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ.

items.t: Paradise is nearer to you than the strap of your sandal, and so is the Fire
items.q: about how near Paradise and the Fire are to a person
items.intro: Ibn Mas'ud (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Jannah is nearer to anyone of you than your shoe-lace, and so is the (Hell) Fire".
ar: ١٠٥- الحادي عشر: عن ابن مسعود -رضي اللَّه عنه-، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبيّ ﷺ: ﴿الجَنَّةُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مِنْ شِرَاكِ نَعْلِهِ، وَالنَّارُ مِثلُ ذلِكَ﴾

items.t: Faith has over seventy branches
items.q: about the branches of faith
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him):
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Iman has over seventy branches - or over sixty branches - the uppermost of which is the declaration: 'None has the right to be worshipped but Allah'; and the least of which is the removal of harmful object from the road, and modesty is a branch of Iman.".
ar: ١٢٥- التاسع: عَنْهُ، عن النَّبيّ ﷺ، قَالَ: ﴿الإيمانُ بِضْعٌ وَسَبعُونَ أَوْ بِضعٌ وسِتُونَ شُعْبَةً: فَأفْضَلُهَا قَولُ: لا إلهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَأَدْنَاهَا إمَاطَةُ الأذَى عَنِ الطَّريقِ، والحياءُ شُعبَةٌ مِنَ الإيمان﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ.
﴿البِضْعُ﴾ من ثلاثة إِلَى تسعة بكسر الباء وقد تفتح. وَ﴿الشُّعْبَةُ﴾: القطعة.

items.t: Whoever guides to good has a reward like the one who does it
items.q: about the reward for guiding to good
items.intro: Abu Mas'ud 'Uqbah bin 'Amr Al-Ansari Al-Badri (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whoever guides someone to virtue will be rewarded equivalent to him who practices that good action".
ar: ١٧٣- وعن أَبي مسعود عُقبةَ بنِ عمرو الأنصاري البدري -رضي اللَّه عنه- قَالَ: قَالَ رسولُ اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى خَيْرٍ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أجْرِ فَاعِلِهِ﴾

items.t: The signs of a hypocrite are three
items.q: about the three signs of a hypocrite
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Three are the signs of a hypocrite: When he speaks, he lies; when he makes a promise, he breaks it; and when he is trusted, he betrays his trust.".Another narration adds the words: "Even if he observes Saum (fasts), performs Salat (prayer) and claims to be a Muslim."
ar: ١٩٩- وعن أَبي هريرة -رضي اللَّه عنه-: أن رَسُول اللَّه ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿آيةُ المُنافقِ ثلاثٌ: إِذَا حَدَّثَ كَذَبَ، وَإِذَا وَعدَ أخْلَفَ، وَإِذَا اؤْتُمِنَ خَانَ﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ.
وفي رواية: ﴿وَإِنْ صَامَ وَصَلَّى وَزَعَمَ أنَّهُ مُسْلِمٌ﴾.

items.t: A Muslim is one from whose tongue and hand Muslims are safe
items.q: about who is a Muslim and who is an emigrant
items.intro: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'as (May Allah bepleased with them) reported:
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A Muslim is the one from whose tongue and hands the Muslims are safe; and a Muhajir (Emigrant) is the one who refrains from what Allah has forbidden".
ar: ٢١١- وعن عبد اللَّه بن عمرو بن العاص رضي اللَّه عنهما عن النَّبيّ ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿المُسْلِمُ منْ سَلِمَ المُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ لِسَانِهِ وَيَدِهِ، وَالمُهَاجِرُ مَنْ هَجَرَ مَا نَهَى اللَّهُ عَنْهُ﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ.

items.t: The believers are like a building whose parts support one another
items.q: about believers being like a building
items.intro: Abu Musa (May Allah bepleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The relationship of the believer with another believer is like (the bricks of) a building, each strengthens the other." He (ﷺ) illustrated this by interlacing the fingers of both his hands.
ar: ٢٢٢- وعن أَبي موسى -رضي اللَّه عنه- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُول اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿المُؤْمِنُ للْمُؤْمِنِ كَالبُنْيَانِ يَشُدُّ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضَاً﴾ وشبَّكَ بَيْنَ أصَابِعِهِ. مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ.

items.t: In their love, mercy and compassion the believers are like one body
items.q: about believers being like one body
items.intro: Nu'man bin Bashir (May Allah bepleased with them) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The believers in their mutual kindness, compassion and sympathy are just like one body. When one of the limbs suffers, the whole body responds to it with wakefulness and fever".
ar: ٢٢٤- وعن النعمان بن بشير رضي اللَّه عنهما، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُول اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿مَثَلُ المُؤْمِنينَ في تَوَادِّهِمْ وتَرَاحُمهمْ وَتَعَاطُفِهمْ، مَثَلُ الجَسَدِ إِذَا اشْتَكَى مِنْهُ عُضْوٌ تَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ الجَسَدِ بِالسَّهَرِ والحُمَّى﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ.

items.t: Allah does not show mercy to one who shows no mercy to people
items.q: about the one to whom Allah does not show mercy
items.intro: Jarir bin 'Abdullah (May Allah bepleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who is not merciful to people Allah will not be merciful to him.".
ar: ٢٢٧- وعن جرير بن عبد اللَّه -رضي اللَّه عنه- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُول اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَم النَّاسَ لاَ يَرْحَمْهُ اللَّه﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ.

items.t: Each of you is a shepherd and responsible for his flock
items.q: about each of you being a shepherd
items.intro: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "All of you are guardians and are responsible for your subjects. The ruler is a guardian of his subjects, the man is a guardian of his family, the woman is a guardian and is responsible for her husband's house and his offspring; and so all of you are guardians and are responsible for your subjects.".
ar: ٢٨٣- وعن ابن عمر رضي اللَّه عنهما، عن النَّبيّ ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿كلكم رَاعٍ، وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْؤُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ: وَالأمِيرُ رَاعٍ، والرَّجُلُ رَاعٍ عَلَى أهْلِ بَيتِهِ، وَالمَرْأةُ رَاعِيةٌ عَلَى بَيْتِ زَوْجها وَوَلَدهِ، فَكُلُّكُمْ رَاعٍ، وَكُلُّكُمْ مَسْؤُولٌ عَنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ.

items.t: Jibril kept advising me about the neighbour
items.q: about Jibril's advice regarding the neighbour
items.intro: Ibn 'Umar and 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Jibril kept recommending treating neighbours with kindness until I thought he would assign a share of inheritance".
ar: ٣٠٣- وعن ابن عمر وعائشة رضي اللَّه عنهما، قالا: قَالَ رَسُول اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿مَا زَالَ جِبْريلُ يُوصِيني بِالجَارِ حَتَّى ظَنَنْتُ أنَّهُ سَيُورِّثُهُ﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ.

items.t: May he be humiliated who finds his parents in old age and does not enter Paradise
items.q: about one who finds his parents in old age and does not enter Paradise
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "May he be disgraced! May he be disgraced! May he be disgraced, whose parents, one or both, attain old age during his life time, and he does not enter Jannah (by rendering being dutiful to them)".
ar: ٣١٧- وعنه، عن النَّبيّ ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿رغِم أنفُ، ثُمَّ رَغِمَ أنْفُ، ثُمَّ رَغِمَ أنْفُ مَنْ أدْرَكَ أبَويهِ عِنْدَ الكِبَرِ، أَحَدهُما أَوْ كِليهمَا فَلَمْ يَدْخُلِ الجَنَّةَ﴾

items.t: Whoever wishes his provision increased and his life extended, let him keep ties of kinship
items.q: about what increases provision and extends life
items.intro: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who desires ample provisions and his life be prolonged, should maintain good ties with his blood relations". .
ar: ٣١٩- وعن أنسٍ -رضي اللَّه عنه- أن رَسُول اللَّه ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿من أحَبَّ أنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ في رِزْقِهِ، ويُنْسأَ لَهُ في أثَرِهِ، فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ. ومعنى ﴿ينسأ لَهُ في أثرِهِ﴾، أي: يؤخر لَهُ في أجلِهِ وعمرِهِ.

items.t: A person will be with those he loves
items.q: about a person being with those he loves
items.intro: Abu Musa Al-Ash'ari (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "A person will be summoned with the one whom he loves"..Another narration is: The Prophet (ﷺ) was asked; "What about a person who loves a people but cannot be with them?" (i.e., either he cannot attain their lofty position of righteousness or that he has not met with them in this life). He (ﷺ) replied, "A person will be in the company of those whom he loves".
ar: ٣٦٨- وعن أَبي موسى الأشعري -رضي اللَّه عنه-: أن النَّبيّ ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿المَرْءُ مَعَ مَنْ أَحَبَّ﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ. وفي رواية: قيل للنبي ﷺ: الرَّجُلُ يُحبُّ القَومَ وَلَمَّا يَلْحَقْ بِهِمْ؟ قَالَ: ﴿المَرْءُ مَعَ مَنْ أَحَبَّ﴾.

items.t: Whoever has three qualities will taste the sweetness of faith
items.q: about the three qualities that give the sweetness of faith
items.intro: Anas bin Malik (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are three qualities whoever has them, will taste the sweetness of Iman: To love Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ) more than anyone else; to love a slave (of Allah) only for (the sake of) Allah; and to abhor returning to infidelity after Allah has saved him from it as he would abhor to be thrown into the fire (of Hell)".
ar: ٣٧٥- وعن أنسٍ -رضي اللَّه عنه- عن النَّبيّ ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿ثَلاثٌ مَنْ كُنَّ فِيهِ وَجَدَ بِهِنَّ حَلاوَةَ الإيمانِ: أنْ يَكُونَ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أحَبَّ إِلَيْهِ مِمَّا سَوَاهُمَا، وَأنْ يُحِبّ المَرْءَ لاَ يُحِبُّهُ إلاَّ للهِ، وَأَنْ يَكْرَهَ أنْ يَعُودَ في الكُفْرِ بَعْدَ أنْ أنْقَذَهُ اللَّه مِنْهُ، كَمَا يَكْرَهُ أنْ يُقْذَفَ في النَّارِ﴾ مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيهِ.

items.t: By the One in whose hand is my soul, you will not enter Paradise until you believe
items.q: about what brings about mutual love
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "By Him in Whose Hand my soul is! You will not enter Jannah until you believe, and you shall not believe until you love one another. May I inform you of something, if you do, you love each other. Promote greeting amongst you (by saying As-salamu 'alaikum to one another)".
ar: ٣٧٨- وعنه، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُول اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿والَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ، لا تَدْخُلُوا الجَنَّةَ حَتَّى تُؤْمِنُوا، وَلا تُؤْمِنُوا حَتَّى تَحَابُّوا، أوَلاَ أدُلُّكُمْ عَلَى شَيْءٍ إِذَا فَعَلْتُمُوهُ تَحَابَبْتُمْ؟ أفْشُوا السَّلامَ بينكم﴾

items.t: The five prayers are like a flowing river at the door of each of you
items.q: about the five prayers being like a river at the door
items.intro: Jabir (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The five daily Salat (prayers) are like a great river running by your door in which you take a bath five times a day.".
ar: ٤٢٩- وعن جابر -رضي اللَّه عنه- قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُول اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿مَثَلُ الصَّلَوَاتِ الخَمْسِ كَمَثَلِ نَهْرٍ جَارٍ غَمْرٍ عَلَى بَابِ أحَدِكُمْ يَغْتَسِلُ مِنْهُ كُلَّ يَوْم خَمْسَ مَرَّات﴾
﴿الغَمْرُ﴾: الكَثِيرُ.

items.t: Richness is not abundance of wealth, true richness is richness of the soul
items.q: about what true richness is
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Richness is not the abundance of wealth, rather it is self-sufficiency.".
ar: ٥٢٢- عن أَبي هريرة -رضي اللَّه عنه- عن النبي ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿لَيْسَ الغِنَى عَن كَثرَةِ العَرَض، وَلكِنَّ الغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ﴾ متفقٌ عَلَيْهِ.
﴿ العَرَضُ﴾ بفتح العين والراءِ: هُوَ المَالُ.

items.t: Protect yourselves from the Fire even with half a date
items.q: about protection from the Fire even with half a date
items.intro: 'Adi bin Hatim (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Protect yourself from Hell-fire even by giving a piece of date as charity.".
ar: ٥٤٦- وعن عَدِيِّ بن حَاتِمٍ -رضي اللَّه عنه- أنَّ رسول اللَّه ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿اتَّقُوا النَّارَ وَلَوْ بِشِقِّ تَمْرَةٍ﴾ متفقٌ عَلَيْهِ.

items.t: Charity does not decrease wealth
items.q: about charity not decreasing wealth
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Wealth is not diminished by giving (in charity). Allah augments the honour of one who forgives; and one who displays humbleness towards another seeking the pleasure of Allah, Allah exalts him in ranks.".
ar: ٥٥٦- وعن أَبي هريرة -رضي اللَّه عنه- أنَّ رسول اللَّه ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَال، وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْداً بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزّاً، وَمَا تَواضَعَ أحَدٌ لله إِلاَّ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى﴾

items.t: Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness in all matters
items.q: about Allah being Gentle and loving gentleness
items.intro: 'Aishah (May Allah be pleased with her) reported:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Allah is Forbearer and loves forbearance in all matters.".
ar: ٦٣٣- وعن عائشة رضي اللَّه عنها، قالت: قَالَ رسول اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿إنَّ اللَّهَ رفيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ فِي الأَمْرِ كُلِّه﴾ متفقٌ عَلَيْهِ.

items.t: Make things easy, not difficult; give glad tidings, do not repel
items.q: about making things easy, not difficult
items.intro: Anas (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Make things easy and do not make them difficult, cheer the people up by conveying glad tidings to them and do not repulse (them).".
ar: ٦٣٧- وعن أنس -رضي اللَّه عنه- عن النبيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿يَسِّرُوا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرُوا وَبَشِّرُوا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرُوا﴾ متفقٌ عَلَيْهِ.

items.t: When a person dies, his deeds come to an end except three
items.q: about the three deeds that continue after death
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "When a man dies, his deeds come to an end, except for three: A continuous charity, knowledge by which people derive benefit, pious son who prays for him.".
ar: ٩٤٩- وعن أَبي هريرة -رضي اللَّه عنه- أنَّ رسول اللَّه ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿إِذَا مَاتَ الإنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاثٍ: صَدَقةٍ جَاريَةٍ، أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ، أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ﴾

items.t: Read the Quran, for it will come as an intercessor for its companions
items.q: about the Quran interceding for those who read it
items.intro: Abu Umamah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying, "Read the Qur'an, for it will come as an intercessor for its reciters on the Day of Resurrection.".
ar: ٩٩١- عن أَبي أُمَامَةَ -رضي اللَّه عنه- قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رسولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يقول: ﴿اقْرَؤُوا القُرْآنَ؛ فَإنَّهُ يَأتِي يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ شَفِيعاً لأَصْحَابِهِ﴾

items.t: Prayer in congregation is twenty-seven degrees better than prayer alone
items.q: about the superiority of congregational prayer
items.intro: Ibn 'Umar (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Salat in congregation is twenty-seven times more meritorious than a Salat performed individually.".
ar: ١٠٦٤- عن ابن عمر رضي اللَّه عنهما أنَّ رَسُول اللَّهِ ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿صَلاَةُ الْجَمَاعَة أفْضَلُ مِنْ صَلاَةِ الْفَذِّ بِسَبْعٍ وَعِشْرِينَ دَرَجَةً﴾ متفقٌ عَلَيْهِ.

items.t: Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and hope of reward, his past sins are forgiven
items.q: about fasting Ramadan with faith and hope of reward
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "He who observes fasting during the month of Ramadan with Faith while seeking its reward from Allah, will have his past sins forgiven.".
ar: ١٢١٩- وعن أَبي هريرة -رضي اللَّه عنه- عن النبيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ إيمَاناً وَاحْتِسَاباً، غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ﴾ متفقٌ عَلَيْهِ.

items.t: Whoever performs Hajj without obscenity or sin returns as on the day his mother bore him
items.q: about the Hajj after which a person is as on the day he was born
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Whoever performs Hajj (pilgrimage) and does not have sexual relations (with his wife), nor commits sin, nor disputes unjustly (during Hajj), then he returns from Hajj as pure and free from sins as on the day on which his mother gave birth to him.".
ar: ١٢٧٤- وعنه، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رسولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ يقول: ﴿مَنْ حَجَّ، فَلَمْ يَرْفُثْ، وَلَمْ يَفْسُقْ، رَجَعَ كَيَوْمِ وَلَدَتْهُ أمُّهُ﴾ متفقٌ عَلَيْهِ.

items.t: Whoever Allah wishes good for, He gives him understanding of the religion
items.q: about whom Allah grants understanding of the religion
items.intro: Mu'awiyah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Messenger of Allah said, "When Allah wishes good for someone, He bestows upon him the understanding of Deen.".
ar: ١٣٧٦- وعن معاوية -رضي اللَّه عنه- قَالَ: قَالَ رسول اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْراً يُفَقِّهْهُ في الدِّينِ﴾. متفقٌ عَلَيْهِ.

items.t: Whoever sends blessings upon me once, Allah blesses him ten times
items.q: about the reward for sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ
items.intro: 'Abdullah bin 'Amr bin Al-'As (May Allah be pleased with them) reported:
ru: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) saying: "Whoever supplicates Allah to exalt my mention, Allah will exalt his mention ten times.".
ar: ١٣٩٧- وعن عبد اللَّه بن عمرو بن العاص رضي اللَّه عنهما أنَّه سمع رسول اللَّه ﷺ يقول: ﴿مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيَّ صَلاةً، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ بِهَا عَشْراً﴾.

items.t: Two words beloved to the Most Merciful, light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale
items.q: about two words light on the tongue and heavy on the Scale
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "There are two statements that are light for the tongue to remember, heavy in the Scales and are dear to the Merciful: 'Subhan-Allahi wa bihamdihi, Subhan-Allahil-Azim .
ar: ١٤٠٨- وعن أَبي هريرة -رضي اللَّه عنه- قَالَ: قَالَ رسُولُ اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي المِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمانِ: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ العظيمِ﴾. متفقٌ عَلَيْهِ.

items.t: The servant is nearest to his Lord when prostrating, so supplicate much
items.q: about when the servant is nearest to his Lord
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "A slave becomes nearest to his Rubb when he is in prostration. So increase supplications while prostrating.".
ar: ١٤٢٨- وعن أَبي هريرة -رضي اللَّه عنه- أنَّ رسول اللَّه ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿أقْرَبُ مَا يَكُونُ العَبْدُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَهُوَ سَاجِدٌ، فَأَكْثِرُوا الدُّعَاءَ﴾.

items.t: I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he remembers Me
items.q: about Allah being as His servant thinks of Him (hadith qudsi)
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) reported:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Allah the Exalted says: 'I am as my slave expects me to be, and I am with him when he remembers Me. If he remembers Me inwardly, I will remember him inwardly, and if he remembers Me in an assembly, I will remember him in a better assembly (i.e., in the assembly of angels).".
ar: ١٤٣٥- وعن أَبي هريرة -رضي اللَّه عنه- أنَّ رسولَ اللَّه ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿يقول اللَّه تَعَالَى: أنا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي، فإنْ ذَكَرَنِي في نَفْسِهِ، ذَكَرْتُهُ في نَفْسِي، وإنْ ذَكَرنِي في ملأٍ ذَكرتُهُ في مَلأٍ خَيْرٍ مِنْهُمْ﴾ متفق عَلَيْهِ.

items.t: A talebearer will not enter Paradise
items.q: about the talebearer
items.intro: Hudhaifah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "The person who goes about with calumnies will never enter Jannah.".
ar: ١٥٣٦- وعن حُذَيْفَةَ -رضي اللَّه عنه- قَالَ: قَالَ رسولُ اللَّه ﷺ: ﴿لا يَدْخُلُ الجَنَّةَ نَمَّامٌ﴾.متفق عَلَيْهِ.

items.t: Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the most false of speech
items.q: about bad suspicion of people
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Beware of suspicion, for suspicion is the worst of false tales.".
ar: ١٥٧٣- وعن أَبي هريرة -رضي اللَّه عنه- أنَّ رسول اللَّه ﷺ قَالَ: ﴿إيَّاكُمْ والظَّنَّ، فإنَّ الظَّنَّ أكْذَبُ الحَدِيثِ﴾. متفق عَلَيْهِ.

items.t: I have prepared for My righteous servants what no eye has seen
items.q: about what Allah has prepared for the righteous (hadith qudsi)
items.intro: Abu Hurairah (May Allah be pleased with him) said:
ru: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "Allah, the Exalted, has said: 'I have prepared for my righteous slaves what no eye has seen, no ear has heard, and the mind of no man has conceived.' If you wish, recite: 'No person knows what is kept hidden for them of joy as a reward for what they used to do."' (32:17).
ar: ١٨٨١- وعن أَبي هريرة -رضي اللَّه عنه- قَالَ: قَالَ رسولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: ﴿قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى: أعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِي الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ، وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ، وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ، وَاقْرَؤُوا إنْ شِئْتُمْ: ﴿فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنِ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ [السجدة: 17]﴾. متفق عَلَيْهِ.
